config.//: Tail entitlement-service's database; one connector per service DB (DB-per-service).
config.//2: Per-service copy of debezium/outbox-connector.json (see docker/README.md) — only the
config.//4: EntitlementGranted/EntitlementRevoked — the events that open/close the carwash
config.//5: module gate (carwash-service's entitlement_projection consumer). Without this
config.//6: connector a live carwash POS 403s not-entitled forever.
config.plugin.name: pgoutput
config.slot.name: entitlement_outbox_slot
config.publication.name: entitlement_outbox_pub
config.//table: Capture ONLY the transactional outbox table (rule 3: publish via the outbox).
config.//binary: payload is a bytea column shipped as base64 text via StringConverter; the
config.//binary2: consumer's libs/events Base64ByteArrayDeserializer decodes it back to Avro bytes.
config.//topic: Route to a topic named exactly after the event_type (no prefix), so the value
config.//topic2: lands on e.g. `EntitlementGranted` — the topic carwash-service's @KafkaListener
config.//headers: Expose the outbox row id + company_id + traceparent as Kafka headers; the
config.//headers2: consumer dedupes by the `id` header (the durable event id), not by offset (HR-3).
